basic_info.description: This 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom penthouse in a two-unit building combines modern luxury with a prime location. The main level features an open floor plan with a sunlit living room framed by walls of windows, showcasing breathtaking views of the city, USF, and a peek at the Golden Gate Bridge. It also includes two spacious bedrooms, a sleek renovated bathroom with a floating marble vanity, a washer/dryer closet, and a gourmet kitchen with slab marble counters and stainless steel appliances. The upper-level primary suite is a private retreat, complete with a cozy fireplace, built-in bookcases, and expansive picture windows framing stunning views. The en-suite features a stall shower, walk-in closet, and direct access to a private rooftop deck, enclosed by glass walls for great cityscapes and dazzling night views. Additional highlights include a large storage space, 1-car independent garage parking, and no monthly HOA fees. Just one block from Buena Vista Park and a short stroll to Cole Valley's vibrant shops and restaurants, this home also offers easy access to Highways 101 and 280. This home checks all your boxes! Don't miss this rare opportunity!
